label: Flesch Reading-Ease of text
description: Flesch Reading-Ease readability score computed from a raw English text string. Counts words, sentences, and syllables from the text and applies 206.835 - 1.015*(words/sentences) - 84.6*(syllables/words). English-only; syllable counting and sentence segmentation are approximate.
summary: New function: Flesch Reading-Ease of text
